items.q: Volta's sales grew from 5,600 to 7,350 bikes while the market grew by 20%. What happened to Volta's market share?
opts: It fell, because the market grew
It rose, because Volta's sales grew by 31.25%, faster than the market
You cannot tell without the price
It stayed the same
items.why: 1,750 ÷ 5,600 × 100 = 31.25%. Volta grew faster than the market (20%), so its share rose (from 3.2% to 3.5%).

items.q: Why should Volta be careful about relying on the 155% figure?
opts: It only measures revenue, not profit
Marketing spending always pays for itself
Return on marketing spend can never be above 100%
The profit from marketing is an estimate, and some sales may have happened without the adverts
items.why: It is hard to know which sales were caused by marketing. If the profit figure is too high, the return is overstated.

items.q: A business raises its price by 10% and quantity demanded falls by 6%. What is the PED?
items.label: Calculate

items.q: Fernhill sells 2.4 million packs at £4.50. PED is -0.6. It raises the price to £4.95. What will revenue be?
items.why: Price rises 10%, so quantity falls 6% to 2,256,000 packs. Revenue = 2,256,000 × £4.95 = £11,167,200, up from £10,800,000.
items.label: Calculate

items.q: The premium range also has a YED of +1.6 and incomes are expected to fall by 2%. Which is the best conclusion?
opts: The price rise will definitely increase revenue by 3.4%
The price rise increases revenue, but falling incomes could cut demand by about 3.2% as well, so the gain may be smaller than expected
YED and PED cannot affect demand at the same time
Falling incomes will increase demand for the premium range
items.why: 1.6 × -2 = -3.2%. Both the price rise and the fall in incomes push demand down, so the extra revenue from the price rise could be partly or fully lost.
items.label: Use the answer

items.q: What does an index of 435 mean?
opts: Revenue in 2025 was about 4.35 times the 2022 level, a rise of about 335%
Revenue rose by 435%
Revenue in 2025 was £435
Revenue fell
items.why: An index of 435 means 435% of the base year, which is a rise of 335%. Watch out for this: the rise is the index minus 100.
